message: Mavrixfy 2.6.0 is available with a refreshed Home experience, improved discovery, smoother playback controls, and better overall stability.
changelog: Refreshed Home experience with improved music discovery
Improved search results for songs, albums, artists, and playlists
Enhanced player, queue, and song option controls
Improved artist and playlist pages for easier browsing
More reliable downloads and offline listening flows
Better Android Auto playback and media navigation

features.title: Improved Discovery
features.description: A refreshed Home screen, better featured artists, new releases, and stronger recommendations.

features.title: Smoother Playback
features.description: Cleaner player controls, improved queue handling, and better Android Auto support.

features.title: More Reliable Experience
features.description: Search, downloads, navigation, and overall app stability have been improved.
